conclusion.rationale: The patch changes usr_drift_protected_paths matching from prefix/exact matching (startswith/==) to fnmatch glob matching. 5 of 96 test cases show regressions where previously protected paths are no longer matched. Bare directory paths like /usr/lib, /usr/local, and /etc lose subdirectory protection coverage. The behavioral change is confirmed by a standalone contract harness achieving 100% patch line coverage. Full DNF integration testing is blocked by missing system libraries on this host.
recommended_actions: Update existing usr_drift_protected_paths configurations to use '/*' suffix for directory-level protection (e.g., /usr/lib -> /usr/lib/*)
Install python3-hawkey, python3-libdnf, python3-libcomps, python3-rpm, python3-librepo, python3-gpg and rerun full DNF test suite to verify integration behavior
